title: Departure Rollovers: Serving Days Funded Through the End of the Following Month (School Nutrition Services Meal Account)
content:
The serving days a departure rollover to a School Nutrition Services Meal Account funds run from the day after the rollover date through the end of the calendar month after it: the serving days left in the month of the rollover date together with the serving days of the calendar month after it.

The district's 2026-27 calendar serves meals on every weekday from August 12, 2026 through May 27, 2027, except Labor Day (September 7), October 12, the Thanksgiving week (November 23 through 27), the winter break (December 21 through January 1), January 18, February 15, the spring break (March 15 through 19) and March 26, and it serves no meals in June or July.

The serving days a departure rollover to a School Nutrition Services Meal Account funds left in the month of the rollover date are the weekdays after the rollover date through the last day of that month on which that calendar serves meals, less the calendar's closures that fall among them; a rollover date before August 12, 2026 counts from August 12, 2026, and a rollover date in July 2026 or after May 27, 2027 leaves none.

| Month of the rollover date | Serving days of the calendar month after it |
|---|---|
| July 2026 | 14 (August) |
| August 2026 | 21 (September) |
| September 2026 | 21 (October) |
| October 2026 | 16 (November) |
| November 2026 | 14 (December) |
| December 2026 | 19 (January) |
| January 2027 | 19 (February) |
| February 2027 | 17 (March) |
| March 2027 | 22 (April) |
| April 2027 | 19 (May) |
| May 2027 | none (June) |
| June 2027 | none (July) |

For a rollover date outside July 2026 through June 2027 the serving days a departure rollover to a School Nutrition Services Meal Account funds are twenty (20): no serving day is left in its month on that calendar, and twenty are counted for the month after.

## Questions on the count (hypothetical dates)

**On a rollover date of Tuesday, April 20, 2027, how many serving days are counted?** 27. Left in its month: 8 (April 21 to 23 and April 26 to 30); month after: 19.

**On a rollover date of Wednesday, November 18, 2026, how many serving days are counted?** 17. Left in its month: 3 (November 19, 20 and 30; the Thanksgiving week is closed); month after: 14.

**On a rollover date of Wednesday, August 5, 2026, how many serving days are counted?** 35. Left in its month: 14 (counted from August 12 through August 31); month after: 21.

**On a rollover date of Friday, May 28, 2027, how many serving days are counted?** 0. Left in its month: none (after May 27, 2027); month after: none.

**On a rollover date of Tuesday, July 6, 2027, how many serving days are counted?** 20. Left in its month: outside July 2026 through June 2027; month after: not applicable, the date being outside the 2026-27 year.
